name: Breath Draw
description: Draw one long breath and send qi through the chest so the user's arms carry more force on the next motion.

name: Skin Reading
description: Spread a thin film of qi over the skin to feel the turn of the air and mark any movement close by.

name: Gusting Palm
description: Push the open palm forward and loose a short burst of air that jolts the target in the chest.

name: Draft Skip
description: Ride a small current along the floor to slide one pace aside without lifting the feet.

name: Soft Eddy
description: Turn the wrist to curl the air before the forearm so a thrown object slides past the body.

name: Flick Cut
description: Flick two fingers to loose a thin blade of pressed air that nicks cloth and skin at short range.

name: Gale Jab
description: Drive the fist straight out and let a hard rod of air follow it into the target's ribs.
first_area: Chapter 006 — The Edge of the Forest (Ref: 1.1.1.006)

name: Breeze Guard
description: Hold both forearms before the body and keep a cushion of moving air that softens blows against the user.

name: Slide Draft
description: Let a pulse of air under the heel carry the user in a short low glide toward or away from a foe.

name: Wrist Whip
description: Snap the wrist to send a cracking line of air across the target's face and spoil its aim.

name: Air Shove
description: Press the palm out to shove a flat push of air into a striker's arm and spoil the swing.

name: Deep Lung
description: Fill the lungs fully and bind qi to the breath so the user's stamina holds through a longer exchange.

name: Lean Wind
description: Lean into the airflow and feel which way it bends around bodies and objects a few paces ahead.

name: Pull Draft
description: Draw the palm back to pull a stream of air and tug an opponent's lead foot off its line.

name: Whorl Palm
description: Cup the palm to trap a pocket of air and slap it against the target so the blow lands hard.

name: Lull Guard
description: Still the air close about the body so that blows meet a dead pocket and lose some of their force.

name: Cool Draw
description: Draw cool air deep into the chest to steady the heart and clear a tired head for the user.

name: Skim Slide
description: Skim the soles over a thin layer of moving air to cross a short gap in one smooth motion.

name: Air Taste
description: Draw air over the tongue and the nose to read smoke or poison or fresh trails carried on the wind.

name: Gust Kick
description: Whip the leg forward and let a burst of air ride the shin into the target's thigh.

name: Double Puff
description: Throw two quick puffs of hard air in a row so the second lands as the target flinches from the first.

name: Heel Draft
description: Kick a draft from the rear heel to spring the user forward one long pace.

name: Back Draft
description: Push a draft against the ground ahead to roll the user backward out of reach of a close attacker.

name: Pivot Breeze
description: Pivot on the ball of the foot and spin a ring of air that turns a straight blow aside.

name: Ankle Sweep
description: Sweep a low band of air across the ankles to trip a charging opponent off balance.

name: Light Foot
description: Wrap the user's legs in a thin cushion of air so each stride lands softer and springs faster.

name: Wind Read
description: Hold still and read the shifts in the air to learn where a moving body is and how fast it comes.

name: Scent Draft
description: Channel a slow draft past the user and carry distant smells to the nose to mark food or smoke or blood.

name: Sound Cup
description: Cup the ear with a bowl of gathered air so faint voices and footfalls carry clearly to the user.

name: Quiet Guard
description: Slow the air in a thick layer before the chest so a thrown blow slows and stings less.

name: Probe Puff
description: Loose a small hard puff at a foe to test its guard and draw out a reaction.

name: Breath Lock
description: Hold the breath and pack qi into the chest so the user steadies through a short burst of effort.

name: Spiral Breath
description: Wind the breath into a tight spiral through the chest and release it to speed the user's next motion.

name: Spinning Palm
description: Coil qi at the waist then unwind it through the palm so a spinning push lands on the target.

name: Whirl Guard
description: Spin the forearm in a small circle and set the air turning so a blow slides off to the side.

name: Spin Pivot
description: Spin on one foot with a pulse of air under it to land a pace away facing the foe.

name: Drill Puff
description: Twist the wrist as a puff leaves the fingertip so it bores into the target as a narrow spinning needle.

name: Coil Feeling
description: Send a slow spiral of air around the body and read where it bends against people and walls.

name: Pinwheel Jab
description: Spin the fist in a wheel and drive a screw of air forward as it lands on the target.

name: Feather Step
description: Lift the body on a cushion of air and land lightly on the toes a long pace away.

name: Feather Palm
description: Strike with a light open hand that carries a sharp snap of air to sting the target's face.

name: Float Guard
description: Keep a floating pad of air before the body that gives under a blow and so blunts its force.

name: Lift Breath
description: Take a high breath and let qi lift through the legs so the user's next leap goes higher.

name: Drifting Sense
description: Let loose threads of air drift outward from the body and note where they are pushed or stopped.

name: Tilt Shove
description: Tilt the palm and shove a slanting push of air that turns an opponent's weapon arm off its aim.

name: Flat Gust
description: Open the whole hand and slam it forward with a thick wave of air behind the palm.

name: Palm Billow
description: Sweep the palm sideways and send a flat wave of air skimming at the target's knees.

name: Palm Turn
description: Meet a blow with the palm and turn it with a short whirl of air so it glances away.

name: Palm Cup
description: Cup both palms before the face and hold a bowl of dense air that stops light missiles.

name: Palm Nudge
description: Press the palm against a foe's raised guard and blow a hard breath of air to break its set.

name: Palm Read
description: Hold the palm out and read the pressure of the air on it to learn what moves nearby.

name: Palm Glide
description: Push the palms back against the air and glide forward a few paces on the recoil.

name: Current Turn
description: Catch a flowing current with the forearm and turn it across the path of an incoming strike.

name: Current Ride
description: Step onto a moving current and let it carry the user a short way in a single smooth glide.

name: Current Cut
description: Chop the edge of the hand through a gathered current and send its force into the target's arm.

name: Current Feel
description: Stand in the flow of air and feel its speed and heat to learn where it comes from.

name: Current Shove
description: Push a bound current into the side of a charging foe so its stride falters and veers.

name: Current Fill
description: Fill the limbs with a steady current of qi and air that lightens the user's tired arms.

name: Breeze Tap
description: Touch the target's arm with the fingertips and loose a quick burst of air against the skin.

name: Breeze Wrap
description: Wrap the body in a close wrap of moving air that catches and slows small thrown objects.

name: Breeze Hop
description: Hop on a gust from below and land one long pace to the side of the foe.

name: Breeze Prick
description: Pinch a thread of air to a point and flick it into a single spot on the target.

name: Breeze Sweep
description: Sweep the arm wide to push a broad breeze that knocks a foe's raised weapon off line.

name: Breeze Ear
description: Carry soft sounds on a thin breeze to the user and learn who speaks or moves beyond the wall.

name: Breeze Fill
description: Draw a steady breeze through the chest to ease the user's breathing and sharpen the next effort.
